metadata.title: Sense codon reassignment enables viral resistance and encoded polymer synthesis

reference.title: Sense codon reassignment enables viral resistance and encoded polymer synthesis

target.condition: Mutated cultures dynamically diluted based on growth rate (details in fig. S1 and supplement)

trigger.observation: Syn61 grows 1.6 times slower than the strain it was derived from, motivating fitness recovery before further engineering.
trigger.reasoning: Increase growth rate of Syn61 before tRNA/RF1 deletion

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Outcome is a measured 1.3-fold growth-rate improvement from growth curves.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Two consecutive rounds of random parallel mutagenesis + automated dynamic parallel selection (feedback-controlled dilution by growth rate; method from ref 19)

target.condition: deletion protocol in supplement (fig. S1C, data S1/S2)

trigger.observation: Syn61's genome already lacks annotated TCG/TCA/TAG codons, predicting its decoders are dispensable; prior work deleted each gene only in separate strains, leaving epistasis untested; sense codons are >=10x more abundant than amber in viral genomes, predicting unreadable sense codons would block full-length viral protein synthesis.
trigger.reasoning: Test whether all decoders of the removed codons can be deleted in one strain, capturing potential epistasis missed by prior separate deletions

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Feasibility rested on the completed genomic recoding and genomic codon counts; viability and phenotype were then measured directly.

alternatives.approach: Separate single deletions (done previously, ref 18) - rejected as insufficient because they do not capture epistasis between serT, serU and prfA

decision_chain.implementation_detail: Deletion of serT, serU and prfA (combined genotype directly demonstrated in this study)

result.after: Viable Syn61Δ3 obtained; grew 1.7x slower than Syn61(ev2). Authors suggest growth defect may reflect unannotated target codons and/or noncanonical tRNA roles (author_interpretation, not causally validated).

decision_chain.rule: Once synonymous codon compression has removed all annotated genomic instances of a codon set, the cognate tRNAs/release factor can be deleted in a single strain; the resulting unreadable codons simultaneously block viral translation and create blank codons for reassignment via orthogonal aaRS/tRNA pairs.

target.condition: as EXP1 (fig. S1, F-H; data S1)

trigger.observation: Syn61Δ3 grew 1.7 times slower than Syn61(ev2) after deletion of serT/serU/prfA.
trigger.reasoning: Recover fitness of Syn61Δ3 after triple deletion

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Measured 1.6-fold growth improvement and doubling time; genome sequenced.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Three sequential rounds of random parallel mutagenesis + automated dynamic parallel selection

result.after: Syn61Δ3(ev5) grew 1.6-fold faster than Syn61Δ3; doubling time 38.72 +/- 1.02 min; 482 additional mutations (420 substitutions, 62 indels, 72 intergenic); no target codon reversion; 16 sense codons in nonessential genes converted to target codons (5xTCG, 3xTCA, 8xTAG). Mutations accumulated across the whole lineage; attribution of specific mutations to individual selection rounds not reported.

target.condition: 4-hour time course; gentamicin arm ablates protein synthesis

trigger.observation: Syn61Δ3(ev5) grew 1.6-fold faster than Syn61Δ3; doubling time 38.72 +/- 1.02 min; 482 additional mutations (420 substitutions, 62 indels, 72 intergenic); no target codon reversion; 16 sense codons in nonessential genes converted to target codons (5xTCG, 3xTCA, 8xTAG). Mutations accumulated across the whole lineage; attribution of specific mutations to individual selection rounds not reported.
trigger.reasoning: Test whether unreadable TCG/TCA/TAG codons block phage propagation and cell lysis

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 自动判定失败——请人工判定
decision_chain.implementation_detail: T6 infection at MOI 5x10^-2 (modified one-step growth); T7 infection; simultaneous cocktail of lambda, P1vir, T4, T6, T7 at MOI 1x10^-2 each

result.after: Syn61Δ3 showed steadily decreasing T6 titer comparable to gentamicin ablation and minimal OD impact; RF1 deletion alone had little/no effect; cocktail lysed Syn61(ev2) and Syn61ΔRF1 but not Syn61Δ3. Scope: tested phages, MOIs, 4-h window; no long-term escape assay.

target.condition: expression in presence/absence of BocK (concentrations in supplement)

trigger.observation: Target codons are unreadable by endogenous machinery in Syn61Δ3 (no product without ncAA), creating orthogonal codons available for reassignment.
trigger.reasoning: Reassign each target codon (TCG/TCA/TAG) to a single ncAA and show endogenous machinery cannot read them

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Reassignment verified by western blot dependence on ncAA and by ESI-MS/MS-MS mass confirmation.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Introduction of orthogonal MmPylRS/MmtRNA_Pyl_YYY pair (anticodon complementary to the target codon; pair from ref 25) plus Ub_11XXX-His6 reporter; +/- BocK

result.after: Little/no ubiquitin without ncAA; BocK addition restored full-length Ub to wt-comparable levels; site-specific BocK incorporation confirmed for each codon

trigger.observation: Single-site reassignment succeeded, prompting test of sequential multi-site incorporation needed for heteropolymer encoding.
trigger.reasoning: Show multi-site incorporation of one ncAA in response to each reassigned codon

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Multi-site products confirmed by ESI-MS mass matching.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Ub genes with 2 (11,65), 3 (11,14,65) or 4 (9,11,14,65) target codons + cognate MmPylRS/MmtRNA_Pyl_YYY pair + BocK; separate experiment: 9 TCG codons in a repeat protein (fig. S6)

result.after: Good yields of Ub incorporating 2-4 BocK per polypeptide in response to each codon; 9 incorporations shown in supplement

trigger.observation: Single-codon reassignment established; synthesizing heteropolymers requires distinct monomers on distinct codons in one cell.
trigger.reasoning: Encode two distinct ncAAs at two distinct codons in one gene

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Dual incorporation verified by western blot and ESI-MS of purified product.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Co-expression of 1R26PylRS(CbzK)/AlvtRNA_ΔNPyl(8)_CGA pair (CbzK->TCG; ref 16) and AfTyrRS(p-I-Phe)/AftRNA_Tyr(A01)_CUA pair (p-I-Phe->TAG; ref 29) with Ub_11TCG,65TAG or Ub_9TCG,11TCG,14TAG,65TAG

result.after: Quantitative incorporation of CbzK at TCG and p-I-Phe at TAG, including 4-site double incorporation (scope: purified products analyzed)

trigger.observation: Double incorporation succeeded; the three blank codons (TCG/TCA/TAG) offer three independent channels if three mutually orthogonal pairs can coexist.
trigger.reasoning: Encode three distinct ncAAs at TCG, TCA and TAG in a single gene

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Triple incorporation verified by western blot and ESI-MS.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Three triply orthogonal pairs: 1R26PylRS(CbzK)/AlvtRNA_CGA (CbzK->TCG), MmPylRS/MmtRNA_Pyl_UGA (BocK->TCA), AfTyrRS(p-I-Phe)/AftRNA_CUA (p-I-Phe->TAG); reporter Ub_9TAG,11TCG,14TCA

result.after: Full-length Ub with three distinct ncAAs produced only with all ncAAs present; mass-confirmed

trigger.observation: Triply orthogonal decoding (EXP8) showed two/three monomers can be placed at distinct codons, implying codon order can program monomer sequence.
trigger.reasoning: Demonstrate programmable encoded ribosomal synthesis of noncanonical heteropolymers from user-written codon sequences

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Products verified by ncAA-dependent expression and ESI-MS of purified fusions.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: sfGFP-His6 with encoded di-/tetra-/hexa-/octamer inserts at codon 3 (TCG/TAG dinucleotide steps AA/BB/AB/BA); three reassignment schemes (r.s.1 AllocK/CbzK, r.s.2 BocK/p-I-Phe, r.s.3 CbzK/p-I-Phe) reprogramming monomer identity on the same DNA; 22 synthetic polymer sequences total

result.after: All encoded polymerizations were ncAA-dependent; hexamer/octamer identities mass-confirmed; cells reprogrammable to different polymers from one DNA sequence

target.condition: expression with r.s.1 pairs (AllocK/CbzK); purification per fig. S13

trigger.observation: sfGFP-fused polymers demonstrated encoding, but applications require free polymers and cyclized products.
trigger.reasoning: Produce free (non-fusion) noncanonical polymers and a macrocycle

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Products purified and confirmed by ESI-MS.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Tetramer/hexamer sequences encoded between SUMO and GyrA-CBD; Ulp1 cleavage + GyrA transthioesterification release free polymers; an upstream cysteine enables self-cleavage and macrocycle release

result.after: Free noncanonical tetramer/hexamer and a macrocycle reminiscent of nonribosomal peptide synthetase products obtained and mass-confirmed

identity.title: Sense codon reassignment enables viral resistance and encoded polymer synthesis

article_type.notes: Science research article reporting original experiments by the authors (strain construction, evolution, phage assays, ncAA incorporation). The bundled 'Designing bacterial superpowers' blurb is the journal's editorial summary of this article, not a separate study.

target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Synthetic recoded genome with all annotated TCG, TCA and TAG replaced by synonymous codons; created in prior work (ref 18, Fredens et al. 2019). Its own ancestor is not named in this paper.
target_strains.genotype: recoded genome (TCG/TCA/TAG removed); full genotype in ref 18 / data S1
target_strains.reasoning: Named in main text as starting strain; recoding itself is background_citation, its use here is current_article.

target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Syn61 after two rounds of random parallel mutagenesis + automated dynamic parallel selection
target_strains.reasoning: Explicitly described construction and 1.3-fold faster growth.

target_strains.paper_strain_normalized: E. coli Syn61Δ3 (= Syn61(ev2) ΔserT ΔserU ΔprfA)
target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Triple deletion of the decoders of TCG/TCA/TAG in Syn61(ev2); first strain unable to read these codons
target_strains.combination_status: demonstrated (combined ΔserT ΔserU ΔprfA directly constructed and verified in one strain)
target_strains.reasoning: Combined genotype directly stated; distinct from prior separate deletions (ref 18).

target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Evolved Syn61Δ3 intermediate used as host for Fig. 4 double/triple ncAA incorporation; construction not described in main text (presumably intermediate of the three post-deletion evolution rounds; data S1)
target_strains.genotype: Syn61Δ3 + evolution-acquired mutations (subset of ev5 set; requires_supplement)
target_strains.reasoning: Name and usage reported; exact relationship to ev5 inferred from naming and Fig. 1 evolution series.

target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Syn61Δ3 after three further rounds of mutagenesis/selection; host for Fig. 3 and Fig. 5 experiments
target_strains.genotype: Syn61Δ3 + 482 additional mutations vs Syn61 (420 substitutions, 62 indels; 72 intergenic); 16 sense codons in nonessential genes converted to target codons
target_strains.reasoning: Explicitly described; doubling time 38.72 ± 1.02 min in LB.

target_strains.lineage_or_engineering_context: Syn61 background with RF1 (prfA) deletion only; used to show RF1 deletion alone does not confer phage resistance
target_strains.reasoning: Named in Results as comparison strain; details in data S1.
